component: the web app: Away's pages around the sessions
keeps: in the browser's own storage, which sessions this browser has open and how wide the list of windows was left
note: Built from the design system's components; the frame is Away's own until the design system has it

component: the session view: the picture, the keys and the pointer, the shell's screen
note: Drawn on a canvas, apart from the pages

component: the server: the pages, the requests, people's sign-ins, the rules, the records
runs: run by the chart, as server
keeps: nothing itself; what it holds is in the database
note: The only part that reaches the database and the sign-in service; it reaches no machine

component: the gateway: the sessions, each with one connection to the browser and one to the machine
runs: run by the chart, as gateway
keeps: in memory and for as long as a session lasts, its picture, a shell's last bytes and what signed it in
note: The only part that reaches machines; the first release runs one

component: the issuer: makes the sign-ins on machines
runs: run by the chart, as issuer
keeps: nothing itself; its authority's keys and the kept accounts are the cluster's
note: It checks a person's sign-in itself before it signs anything; the status page calls it signing in on machines

component: the RDP code
note: For a Windows desktop and its programs, and for desktops of other systems that speak RDP

component: the Windows sign-in: Kerberos, the sign-in before the desktop, the smart card in memory
the VNC code
the SSH code
the shell's screen: turns what a shell writes into what it shows
note: What is elsewhere called a terminal emulator; later it runs in the gateway too, to hold a shell while the browser is closed

component: the picture: a desktop as the gateway keeps it, and the rectangles it sends
the session's messages between the browser and the gateway
runs: in the gateway and in the browser
note: One description that both sides are built from

component: the database
runs: run by the chart, or brought by the operator
keeps: the sign-ins, each person's settings, favourites and last used, the machines' identities, the sessions as they run, the records
note: PostgreSQL

component: the files: the machines, the groups, the rules and the settings
runs: mounted into the server, from a ConfigMap
note: Written by the operator and kept where they keep their configuration

component: the cluster's secrets
keeps: the kept accounts, the issuer's authority keys, each part's own keys
note: Each part has its own mounted; the issuer alone reads the kept accounts

component: the way in: the cluster's router or ingress, as it is there
note: It passes the pages on to the server and a session's connection on to the gateway

component: the sign-in service: the organisation's identity provider
note: Any provider that speaks OpenID Connect

component: the machines
note: Reached the way each already offers: RDP, VNC or SSH; nothing of Away's runs on them

component: the Windows domain: its domain controllers
note: For signing in on its machines as oneself; an installation without one leaves it out and lacks nothing else

component: the organisation's authority: its own certificate authority
note: Where the configuration says that the organisation's own authority issues the Windows sign-ins

component: the log system: the one that is there
note: It collects the lines every part puts out

component: the monitoring: the one that is there
note: It reads every part's measures

component: the chart that installs Away
note: No kinds of its own and no rights beyond its namespace

component: the pipelines: build, test, sign, list, publish
note: Beside the one that is there

component: the pipeline that checks the model and publishes the site
the servers the tests run against: a shell, a desktop over VNC, a desktop over RDP
note: A Windows machine in a domain needs a place of its own

component: the registry the project publishes to
keeps: the image and the chart, their signatures, the records of their builds, the lists of their contents

component: the documentation, the specification and the site
runs: the site is built and published by its pipeline

component: a relay placed in a network Away is not in
note: For machines the gateway can't reach itself
